detail.notFound: Project not found, or you have no access to it.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive this project?
archiveConfirm.message: An archived project is read-only and disappears from default lists and from the issue-create picker. Links to its issues will keep working.

fields.title: Custom fields

scheme.label: Field scheme
scheme.detachHint: Detaching does not delete values stored on issues — they come back when the scheme does.
scheme.empty: This project has no field scheme. Pick one to add custom fields to its issues.

fields.slotWarning: A slot is bound to a field permanently. After saving it cannot be changed — the only way out is deleting the field, and the first stored value blocks that.

add.title: New field
add.name: Name
add.nameKeyHint: optional — without it the field shows the name above, untranslated
add.slotsExhausted: All slots of this type are taken ({{used}}/{{total}}): {{fields}}. Remove one of those fields to free a slot.

remove.label: Remove
remove.confirmMessage: The slot returns to the pool only together with the field. If any issue has a value in it, the server refuses.

types.title: Issue types
types.empty: This scheme has no types yet.

remove.label: Remove
remove.confirmMessage: The backend refuses if any issue still has this type.

tags.title: Tags
tags.empty: No tags visible in this project.

merge.label: Merge into…
merge.confirmMessage: Tag "{{name}}" will be deleted, and every issue carrying it will get the target tag instead. This cannot be undone.
merge.scopeMismatch: You can only merge tags from the same scope — both global, or both belonging to the same project.

automations.title: Automations
automations.empty: This project has no automation rules yet.

removeConfirm.title: Remove rule "{{name}}"
removeConfirm.message: The rule and its run log will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

editor.conditionHint: The rule runs when all conditions in any one group are true (groups are joined by "or", conditions within a group by "and"). Without a condition the rule always runs.
editor.saveFailed: Failed to save the automation rule.
editor.actionRequired: The rule needs at least one action.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.empty: This project has no webhooks yet.

removeConfirm.title: Remove webhook
removeConfirm.message: The webhook and its delivery history will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

webhooks.deliveriesEmpty: This webhook hasn't delivered anything yet.

editor.secretHint: At least 16 characters — signs the payload in the X-Erp-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256).
editor.eventRequired: The webhook needs at least one event.

sla.title: SLA
sla.empty: This project has no SLA policy yet.
sla.saveFailed: Failed to save the project SLA.

workflow.title: Workflow scheme
workflow.noScheme: This project has no workflow scheme attached yet.

states.title: States
states.empty: This scheme has no states yet.

remove.label: Remove
remove.confirmMessage: The state must not be used by any transition. Issues in this state migrate only after a target state is chosen.

transitions.title: Transitions
transitions.matrixHint: The row is the starting state, the column is the target state. Click an empty cell to add a transition, or an existing one to edit it.
transitions.empty: Add at least two states to see the transition matrix.

publish.confirmRemoveMessage: The state has no open issues — removal is immediate.
publish.intro: The states below still have open issues. Choose where they should go before the state disappears from the scheme.
publish.incompleteMapping: Choose a target state for every state being removed.
publish.started: The migration job was started — track progress in the notification bell.
